item.subject: science
item.stem:
Meera's class reads the chapter 'The ever-evolving world of science'. Her teacher says science is more than memorising the textbook.

Which row best describes how science should be treated, according to this chapter?

options.A: science is: a list of facts to memorise; students should: repeat correct answers; questions and experiments are: unnecessary extras
options.B: science is: a way of thinking; students should: ask questions and try experiments; questions and experiments are: central to science
options.C: science is: a list of facts to memorise; students should: ask questions only at home; questions and experiments are: interesting extras
options.D: science is: a finished set of answers; students should: copy notes from the board; questions and experiments are: for scientists only
